Zahn's introduction: this melody belongs to many hymns whose metres vary (troch. 6.5.6.5.6.5.6.5 or iamb. 7.6.7.6.7.6.7.6 plus 'Kyrieleison' or 'Kyrie eleison, Christe eleison, Kyrie eleison', so 9- or 11-line), hence rhythmic variants.
